definition: A man who serves food in a restaurant.
examples: The waiter brought the menu.
We left a tip for the waiter.
He works as a waiter on weekends.

spanish.definition: Hombre que sirve comida en un restaurante.

definition: A person who takes photos.
examples: We hired a wedding photographer.
She's a fashion photographer.
The photographer asked us to smile.

definition: To have enough space for someone; to give someone what they need.
examples: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
We'll try to accommodate your request.
The van accommodated the whole team.

spanish.definition: Tener espacio para alguien; darle a alguien lo que necesita.

definition: Unable to stop using or doing something.
examples: He's addicted to cigarettes.
I'm addicted to this TV show.
Many kids are addicted to their phones.

spanish.definition: Que no puede dejar de usar o hacer algo.

definition: At a high level; modern.
examples: She's in an advanced English class.
This phone uses advanced technology.
He has advanced cancer.

definition: To change something.
examples: The tailor altered my pants.
Nothing can alter my decision.
We've altered our plans for the weekend.

definition: To make someone laugh or smile.
examples: His jokes amused the kids.
She wasn't amused.
The clown is amusing the children.

spanish.definition: Hacer reír o sonreír a alguien.

definition: One part of a situation.
examples: We talked about every aspect of the plan.
Money is an important aspect of this decision.
What aspect of your job do you like best?

definition: Something that blocks the way.
examples: Police put up a barrier across the road.
Language can be a barrier.
The river is a natural barrier.

definition: A person starting to learn something.
examples: This class is for beginners.
I'm a beginner at chess.
She's good for a beginner.

spanish.definition: Persona que empieza a aprender algo.

definition: For a short time; in few words.
examples: We spoke briefly after the meeting.
He stopped briefly at the door.
Let me briefly explain the plan.

spanish.definition: Por poco tiempo; en pocas palabras.

definition: A person who buys something.
examples: We found a buyer for the house.
She's a first-time home buyer.
The buyer paid in cash.

definition: Carefully; in a near way.
examples: Listen closely to the teacher.
They worked closely together.
He looked closely at the photo.

definition: Things you wear.
examples: The store sells children's clothing.
Bring warm clothing for the trip.
She donated some old clothing.

definition: One part of a machine or a system.
examples: The factory makes car components.
Trust is a key component of any relationship.
We replaced a broken component.

spanish.definition: Una parte de una máquina o un sistema.

definition: Difficult to understand.
examples: These directions are confusing.
The movie has a confusing ending.
English spelling is very confusing.

definition: To be made of parts.
examples: The team consists of ten players.
Breakfast consisted of eggs and toast.
The test consists of three parts.

definition: Something you keep things in.
examples: Put the leftovers in a plastic container.
The ship carries large metal containers.
This container holds a gallon of water.

spanish.definition: Algo en lo que guardas cosas.

definition: A red-brown metal.
examples: The wires are made of copper.
She bought copper pots for the kitchen.
Copper is a good conductor.

definition: A long flat surface in a kitchen or a store.
examples: Leave the keys on the counter.
She paid at the counter.
The kitchen has marble counters.

spanish.definition: Superficie larga y plana en una cocina o una tienda.

definition: A set of classes; a part of a meal; a path.
examples: I'm taking an online Spanish course.
The main course was fish.
Of course I'll help you.

spanish.definition: Conjunto de clases; parte de una comida; camino.

definition: Full of people.
examples: The bus was very crowded.
We walked through the crowded streets.
The beach gets crowded in July.

definition: A signal to do something.
examples: That's my cue to leave.
The actor missed his cue.
She came in right on cue.

definition: To become less; a drop in amount.
examples: The number of students has decreased.
Prices decreased last year.
There's been a decrease in crime.

spanish.definition: Volverse menos; caída en una cantidad.

definition: Clear and certain.
examples: We don't have a definite date yet.
I need a definite answer.
There's a definite smell of smoke.

definition: Very happy.
examples: I'm delighted to meet you.
She was delighted with her gift.
We're delighted that you came.

definition: A person who plans how things will look.
examples: She's a fashion designer.
He works as a web designer.
We hired a designer for the kitchen.

spanish.definition: Persona que planea cómo se verán las cosas.

definition: With many small facts.
examples: She gave a detailed report.
I need a more detailed map.
He wrote a detailed description.

definition: The activity of eating a meal.
examples: We ate in the dining room.
The city has great dining.
The dining car is at the end of the train.

definition: Having a condition that makes some activities difficult.
examples: The parking spaces are for disabled drivers.
Her son is disabled.
The bus has seats for disabled people.

spanish.definition: Con una condición que hace difíciles algunas actividades.

definition: Not as good as you hoped.
examples: The movie was disappointing.
It was a disappointing season for the team.
The results were very disappointing.

definition: A picture made with a pencil or a pen.
examples: My son gave me a drawing of our house.
She's good at drawing.
The kids put their drawings on the wall.

spanish.definition: Imagen hecha con lápiz o bolígrafo.

definition: The study of money, trade, and jobs.
examples: She has a degree in economics.
He teaches economics at the university.
I'm taking an economics class.

spanish.definition: Estudio del dinero, el comercio y el trabajo.

definition: In a way that works well.
examples: She communicates very effectively.
This medicine works effectively.
We need to use our time effectively.

spanish.definition: De una manera que funciona bien.

definition: Well and without wasting time or energy.
examples: The new machine runs efficiently.
She works quickly and efficiently.
We need to use water more efficiently.

spanish.definition: Bien y sin perder tiempo ni energía.

definition: Quite old.
examples: She takes care of her elderly mother.
An elderly man sat on the bench.
The center helps elderly people.

definition: To choose someone by voting.
examples: They elected a new president.
She was elected mayor.
We're electing a new class leader.

definition: The last part of a story.
examples: I love movies with a happy ending.
The ending surprised me.
Don't tell me the ending!

spanish.definition: La última parte de una historia.

definition: Having agreed to marry someone.
examples: They got engaged in Paris.
She's engaged to a doctor.
We've been engaged for a year.

definition: The work of designing machines, roads, and bridges.
examples: He studied engineering in college.
She has a degree in civil engineering.
This bridge is a great piece of engineering.

spanish.definition: Trabajo de diseñar máquinas, caminos y puentes.

definition: In the same way or the same amount.
examples: They divided the money equally.
Both kids are equally smart.
We should treat everyone equally.

spanish.definition: De la misma manera o en la misma cantidad.

definition: Connected to a group with a shared culture.
examples: The city has many ethnic groups.
We love ethnic food.
She studies ethnic music.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con un grupo de cultura compartida.

definition: To be more than a limit.
examples: Don't exceed the speed limit.
The cost exceeded $500.
Your bag is exceeding the weight limit.

definition: The activity of catching fish.
examples: We went fishing on the lake.
My dad loves fishing.
He bought a new fishing rod.

definition: A person from another country.
examples: Many foreigners live in this area.
He felt like a foreigner in his own town.
Foreigners need a visa to work here.

definition: Very cold.
examples: It's freezing outside.
I'm freezing! Close the window.
The water was freezing.

definition: Usually; by most people.
examples: I generally get up at seven.
The food is generally good here.
It's generally a safe area.

spanish.definition: Normalmente; por la mayoría de la gente.

definition: Happening slowly.
examples: There's been a gradual change in the weather.
Her recovery was slow and gradual.
The road has a gradual slope.

definition: The mother or father of your parent.
examples: My grandparents live in Cali.
We visit our grandparents every summer.
Grandparents love to spoil their grandchildren.

spanish.definition: La madre o el padre de tu padre o madre.

definition: Very much.
examples: Your help is greatly appreciated.
Prices vary greatly.
The town has greatly changed.

definition: A strong desire for more money than you need.
examples: His greed destroyed the company.
It's all about greed.
Greed made him steal.

spanish.definition: Deseo fuerte de más dinero del que necesitas.

definition: One of the two big lights on the front of a car.
examples: Turn on your headlights.
One of my headlights is broken.
I saw headlights in the distance.

spanish.definition: Una de las dos luces grandes de adelante de un carro.

definition: The ability to hear; a meeting in a court.
examples: My grandfather's hearing is getting worse.
The court hearing is on Monday.
Loud music can damage your hearing.

spanish.definition: Capacidad de oír; reunión en un juzgado.

definition: A machine that makes a room or water warm.
examples: Turn on the heater; it's cold.
The water heater is broken.
We bought a small heater for the bedroom.

spanish.definition: Máquina que calienta un cuarto o el agua.

definition: Places for people to live.
examples: Housing is very expensive in New York.
The city needs more cheap housing.
Students live in campus housing.

definition: To add pictures to a book; to explain with examples.
examples: She illustrates children's books.
This story illustrates my point.
He illustrated his talk with photos.

spanish.definition: Agregar imágenes a un libro; explicar con ejemplos.

definition: To suggest something without saying it directly.
examples: Are you implying I'm lazy?
He implied that she was lying.
Her silence implied a lot.

definition: With something as a part of a group.
examples: The trip costs $500, including meals.
Ten people came, including my boss.
Everyone was tired, including me.

spanish.definition: Con algo como parte de un grupo.

definition: An alphabetical list at the end of a book.
examples: Look in the index at the back.
The book has a good index.
She wrote the number on an index card.

spanish.definition: Lista alfabética al final de un libro.

definition: In a building.
examples: Let's go indoors; it's raining.
The kids played indoors all day.
You can't smoke indoors.

definition: To hurt someone or a part of your body.
examples: He injured his knee in the game.
Two people were injured in the crash.
Be careful or you'll injure yourself.

spanish.definition: Hacerle daño a alguien o a una parte del cuerpo.

definition: Inside; private.
examples: He showed us the inner rooms of the palace.
She found inner peace.
They live in the inner city.

definition: Immediately.
examples: I knew her instantly.
The driver was killed instantly.
The app updates instantly.

definition: In a nice way; friendly.
examples: She kindly offered to help.
Would you kindly close the door?
He was a kindly old man.

definition: Mostly.
examples: The town is largely Spanish-speaking.
The accident was largely his fault.
It's largely a question of money.

definition: A flat level of something on top of another.
examples: Wear several layers when it's cold.
There was a layer of dust on the table.
The cake has three layers.

spanish.definition: Nivel plano de algo sobre otra cosa.

definition: Softly; not much.
examples: She touched my arm lightly.
It rained lightly all morning.
Cook the eggs lightly.

definition: Small in amount.
examples: We have limited time.
This is a limited offer.
Parking is very limited here.

definition: A unit for measuring liquid.
examples: I drink two liters of water a day.
We bought a liter of milk.
The tank holds fifty liters.

definition: The money you earn; alive.
examples: What do you do for a living?
He makes a living as a driver.
All living things need water.

definition: A person who loves something; a romantic partner.
examples: She's a real dog lover.
He's a music lover.
They were lovers for years.

spanish.definition: Persona a la que le encanta algo; pareja romántica.

definition: Mostly.
examples: I mainly eat vegetables.
The students are mainly from Texas.
It's mainly a question of time.

definition: To make things in large numbers in a factory.
examples: The company manufactures car parts.
These toys are manufactured in China.
They're manufacturing a new kind of battery.

spanish.definition: Hacer cosas en grandes cantidades en una fábrica.

definition: The work of promoting and selling products.
examples: She works in marketing.
The company spent a lot on marketing.
He studied marketing in college.

spanish.definition: Trabajo de promover y vender productos.

definition: Having a husband or a wife.
examples: They've been married for ten years.
Are you married?
She's married to a teacher.

definition: What a word or an idea expresses.
examples: What's the meaning of this word?
He's looking for the meaning of life.
This word has two meanings.

spanish.definition: Lo que una palabra o idea expresa.

definition: A way of doing something.
examples: The bus is my only means of transportation.
We have no means of contacting him.
Email is a quick means of communication.

definition: A person who works under the ground to get coal or gold.
examples: His father was a coal miner.
The miners were trapped for days.
Miners work long hours in the dark.

spanish.definition: Persona que trabaja bajo tierra para sacar carbón u oro.

definition: Lost; not in its place.
examples: My keys are missing.
Police are looking for a missing child.
There's a page missing from this book.

spanish.definition: Extraviado; que no está en su lugar.

definition: Happening once a month.
examples: I pay my monthly rent on the first.
The magazine comes out monthly.
We have a monthly meeting.

spanish.definition: Que pasa una vez al mes.

definition: In every case.
examples: Expensive isn't necessarily better.
That's not necessarily true.
Rich people aren't necessarily happy.

definition: Many.
examples: I've told him numerous times.
There are numerous hotels near the beach.
He has numerous health problems.

definition: A hole; the start of something; a job that is free.
examples: The cat escaped through an opening in the fence.
We went to the opening of the new store.
Do you have any openings for a cook?

spanish.definition: Hueco; comienzo de algo; puesto de trabajo libre.

definition: At first.
examples: I'm originally from Bogotá.
The house was originally white.
We originally planned to fly.

definition: Outside; not in a building.
examples: The kids love playing outdoors.
We ate outdoors last night.
She spends a lot of time outdoors.

spanish.definition: Afuera; no dentro de un edificio.

definition: On the outside.
examples: Rockets travel to outer space.
Take off the outer layer.
They live on the outer edge of the city.

definition: In another country across the sea.
examples: She works overseas.
He's on an overseas trip.
We sell a lot of products overseas.

spanish.definition: En otro país al otro lado del mar.

definition: A person who paints pictures or houses.
examples: Picasso was a famous painter.
We hired a painter for the kitchen.
She's a painter and a poet.

spanish.definition: Persona que pinta cuadros o casas.

definition: A picture made with paint.
examples: There's a beautiful painting on the wall.
She sold her first painting.
The museum has many famous paintings.

definition: A person who takes part in something.
examples: Each participant gets a free shirt.
There were fifty participants in the study.
All participants must sign the form.

spanish.definition: Persona que toma parte en algo.

definition: For each.
examples: The speed limit is 60 miles per hour.
It costs ten dollars per person.
I work forty hours per week.

definition: In a way connected to the body.
examples: I'm physically tired.
He's physically very strong.
You don't need to be there physically.

spanish.definition: De una manera relacionada con el cuerpo.

definition: A small truck with an open back; the act of getting someone or something.
examples: He drives an old pickup.
The school pickup is at three.
Your order is ready for pickup.

spanish.definition: Camión pequeño con la parte trasera abierta; acto de recoger a alguien o algo.

definition: Able to kill or make you sick.
examples: Some mushrooms are poisonous.
That snake is poisonous.
The factory released poisonous gas.

definition: To own something.
examples: He doesn't possess a car.
She possesses great talent.
They were arrested for possessing drugs.

definition: Likely to be true or to happen.
examples: It's probable that he'll win.
The probable cause of the fire was a cigarette.
Rain is highly probable tonight.

spanish.definition: Que tal vez sea verdad o pase.

definition: Quick and done without delay.
examples: Thanks for your prompt reply.
The bank gave a prompt answer.
They offer prompt service.

definition: A large part of a country.
examples: Quebec is a province of Canada.
She comes from a small province in Spain.
The country has ten provinces.

definition: A skill or a degree you need for a job.
examples: What are your qualifications for this job?
He has no teaching qualifications.
She has the right qualifications.

spanish.definition: Habilidad o título que necesitas para un trabajo.

definition: An angry argument; to argue.
examples: They had a quarrel about money.
The two brothers quarreled for years.
Stop quarreling, you two!
